NAME-COLLISION HANDLING (explicit, as instructed): this dataset also contains row 242 'Dr Mohan Krishna', PLASTIC / COSMETIC SURGERY at Apollo Secunderabad - a DIFFERENT doctor being researched separately. Everything recorded here is sourced only to pages that say ORTHOPAEDICS and Apollo Jubilee Hills / Apollo Health City. Every Apollo URL above sits under an /orthopedician/ path or an explicitly orthopaedic profile, and both Apollo 24|7 records are titled 'Orthopaedician'. Nothing plastic-surgery-related and nothing sourced to Apollo Secunderabad was used. Anyone reconciling the two rows should keep them separate.

IDENTITY: verified on four criteria - name ('Dr A Mohan Krishna', with the initial expanded to the surname Althuri on one Apollo 24|7 slug), specialty (Orthopaedics/Orthopaedician), hospital (Apollo Hospitals Jubilee Hills / Apollo Health City), city (Hyderabad) - agreeing across THREE independent official sources: (1) apollohospitals.com (four separate pages: region-Hyderabad doctor page, corporate orthopaedician page, city orthopaedician page, international-patient-services page) plus the Apollo group's askapollo.com page which names Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills explicitly; (2) apollo247.com official doctor/booking pages; (3) his own practice sites drmohankrishna.com and bonesandjointsclinic.com, which independently describe him as Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon at Apollo Hospital, Hyderabad, consulting at Jubilee Hills, Manikonda and Gachibowli. Experience 20 years on Apollo vs '16+' in the input row - consistent (Apollo's is the higher figure).

PHONE - EXACT-PHRASE RULE APPLIED: the number 9398664291 first came from a search summary, so per section 4 I re-ran it as a quoted exact-phrase search. It came back attached to real indexed pages: bonesandjointsclinic.com/contact-page/ and his own drmohankrishna.com clinic-consultation page, described as the appointment line answered by his coordinator (Hemanth) for the Jubilee Hills sitting. It is therefore a PUBLISHED PRACTICE / APPOINTMENT line on his own official clinic site, not a scraped personal mobile, and not a directory call-tracking proxy - so it is recorded, in both professional_phone and secretary_number (same single number; secretary_number reflects that a coordinator answers it). Note for the reviewer: it is in an Indian mobile numbering series, which is normal for a consultant-run clinic's published booking line in Hyderabad, but if the brief requires a landline only, drop it and use the Apollo 24|7 booking route instead. Two different Manikonda addresses appear across his sites (Hale Clinics, beside Vijaya Diagnostics / Ramraj Cottons, 500033; and Sai Ram Nagar Colony, Alkapoor township, 500089) - probably an old and a current sitting; a human should confirm which is live.

DELIBERATE OMISSIONS: no email appeared verbatim on any page, so professional_email is blank rather than derived from either of his domains. JustDial listing was ignored (call-tracking proxy). The Facebook page recorded is the clinic's own professional page ('Mohan's Bones & Joints Clinic | Hyderabad'), not a personal account. No LinkedIn, Google Scholar, ORCID or ResearchGate profile surfaced - expected for a Hyderabad private-practice clinician; not treated as a gap. A second Apollo 24|7 record (uuid e1fc612e...) exists alongside the primary one (uuid d042f48b...); both are titled Orthopaedician in Hyderabad, so this looks like a duplicate Apollo record for the same man rather than a second doctor - the d042f48b record is the one used for appointment_link because the same uuid also serves the 'dr-mohan-krishna-althuri' slug, tying the initial 'A' to the surname Althuri.
